notes.title: SPARKNEXA Project Three Kingkoms Showcase
notes.notes: Special collection of the interview series “A Game Aesthete,” featuring Biaoge, the game producer of “Project Three Kingdoms”. Presenting the hidden stories behind the development of “Project Three Kingdoms.” Stay tuned for latest updates!

notes.title: A Long Lasting Mania: "Project Three Kingdoms" Will be Developed into Series
notes.notes:
Hello everyone，we are  the development team of "Project Three Kingdoms"! It's our great pleasure to share our game with you all  on steam! 

"Project Three Kingdoms" is a SRPG game, based on Chinese three kingdoms history. We all hope it will become a game that is loved and recognized by fans of the three kingdoms around the world. 

Check out ourfirst game video. 
[previewyoutube=50Dc8LoyUug;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Recently, "Project Three Kingdoms" had its first look all around the world, after that we have received a lot of enthusiastic feedback. Many media reported and recommended our game and we have received reviews and comments from our tens of thousands of players!It is our great honor to be loved by all of you and it  really  give us great confidence! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902357/cf75f09087eb0c1f413d9fc710ea2b33320def0f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902357/9b61fc7397b9e1682c21b9a90f608114ce853de9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902357/b019d0e780dadeaf4e1284c090137c7a9ce30188.png[/img]
（Reviews from players and famous game media around the world）

We also received a lot of questions. Some players asked, "The Three Kingdoms is classic, but it's no longer the trendiest theme, so why don't you consider the popular styles such as China-Chic or ACG, which can impress more players?"There are also a lot of people asking if you guys are going to replicate Romance Of Three Kingdom?

[b]Here are some answers to questions from our players,hope you will get to know our game better.[/b]

[b]Why do you focus on  three kingdoms?  [/b]
From a utilitarian point of view, three kingdoms them is a classic that has been recreated by a thousand years of Chinese history, and the more you taste it, the stronger the flavour becomes. Three kingdoms is a mark engraved in Chinese culture that will never go out of fashion. More importantly, our team loves and is obsessed with  three kingdoms! Love is the greatest creative impetus. After gathering a group of developers who also love three Kingdoms, we finally have the opportunity to develop our own three kingdoms game.
"Project Three Kingdoms" is intended to be a brand with a number of successive productions. Luckily, there are so many players around the world who also love  three kingdoms. In addition to Cao Cao and Liu Bei scripts, we are currently developing scripts for Dong Wu, Kong Ming's Northern Expedition, and Jiang Wei in our development schedule.


[b]"Project Three Kingdoms”  is not a simple replica of the Legend of CaoCao. [/b]
"Romance Of Three Kingdom:the Legend of CaoCao" is a classic work in my and many players minds. Our game designers can do nothing for 14 days, but we must be able to pass the Legend of CaoCao without any deaths of characters. As a product in  many years ago, "The Legend of CaoCao" is relatively simple in terms of structure, and the amount of content is also slightly insufficient. 
"Project Three Kingdoms” adopts the classic SLG game and  also designs numerous interesting systems. For example, based on the Thirty-Six Strategies and Sun Tzu's Art of War, we have summarised the strategies used in the major classic battles in the history of three kingdoms, and have now designed more than a dozen types of strategies. In the battle, seize the opportunity to use the stratagy, often can play a powerful role in the battle to determine the outcome of the war, and fully experience the sense of achievement of strategising to win beyond a thousand miles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902357/197989a406f65c56b6297287ad2f3ffc83a4b8c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902357/64f351032b30c46f92721d485f70688147a9c6ff.gif[/img]
( in-game warplay skill  interface)

What's more , we have carefully examined the water battles of the past dynasties, restored the real physical performance of the waters through the mechanism of rapids, eddies, reefs, etc., and extracted a number of water battle ship types from the ancient books to form our unique water battle style of play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902357/306c294433a43e5ba6a6007f8dc7ed1b468a5cc7.png[/img]
(in-game water battle play scene )

In addition, we put a lot of effort into "interpretation". Three kingdoms is not only about fighting and killing, but also about civil, poems and songs, and beautiful natural scenary, all of which are worth showing. In order to restore them in our game , the research and development cycle and costs have risen sharply. Fortunately, our  company Sparknexa, still firmly supported us in making fine products, and the final product direction was firmly implemented.

Finally, if you would like to find  more update and timely information, we sincerely welcome all  steam players to follow our official account on Steam, find "Project Three Kingdoms” , and add it to your wishlist,which will serve as the greatest support for us to continue developing our game!
